LanguageData.Raven_ArchonArmor_RegenerativeHarness.de: Specialized armor designed for the Raven High Archon. It continuously heals wounds, increases movement speed, and stabilizes the rider's hunger and sleep needs while mounted.
LanguageData.Raven_ArchonArmor_GoldenAegisSaddle.desc: A heavy external saddle forged for the Raven High Archon. Leaning more towards mobility and protection than the regenerative harness, it provides the rider with more stable protection during high-speed flight and mounted assaults.
